summary: Read a text made only of lowercase English letters, together with an integer k. Both how long the text is and how large k is lie between 1 and 10000. Starting at the left, handle the letters in chunks of 2k. Inside a full chunk, swap the order of the opening k letters and leave the later letters where they are. If the final chunk holds fewer than k letters, swap all of those leftover letters. If it holds at least k letters but fewer than 2k, swap only the opening k letters and leave the later ones where they are. Write the text after this pass.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
